note: Both sets capture the core facts (SIP 4-1/2" with vapor barrier, 2"x8" frame/joist, 8D ring-shank nail @ 6" O.C., continuous sealant and waterproofing, PL 8 x 3/8 with 7/16" holes @ 12" O.C., first floor 2'-4" above grade 0"). Set A repeats several facts two or three times (SIP, frame, joist, sealant, railing post bracket), gives a fragmentary quote "3/4"" for deck thickness, invents the condition "connection to joist" and mislabels the 3/8"x4" hex bolt as a "deck connection bolt". Set B is cleaner and better quoted, splitting the hex bolt into diameter 3/8" and length 4", giving the scaffold footing as ADJUSTABLE, and quoting the full plywood line for decking material and thickness. Both make the same two binding errors (1'-3 1/4" called a RAILING ATTACHMENT segment width, the garbled "ANK NAIL" claim), so B wins on fewer wrong/duplicated claims rather than on unique coverage.
remarks: Both sets omit several visible items: 3" STEEL DECKING, W10 X 15 #, 3" WOOD LAG SCREW WITH WASHER, 3/8" x 4" HEX THROUGH BOLT (distinct from the plain hex bolt), CLEARVUE CABLE RAILING, and the 5'-2 1/2" / 8'-0" / 4'-0" dimensions. The text layer garbles the nail callout into a stray "ANK NAIL @ 6" O.C. EACH" fragment, and both extractions turned that fragment into a claim with a truncated quote; the full callout is 8D RING SHANK NAIL @ 6" O.C. EACH SIDE. The dimension string 1'-4 3/4" / 1'-4" / 1'-3 1/4" is bound inconsistently within each set (one value to RAILING ATTACHMENT, another to "deck connection"), and B's added condition "Detail C1" and A's "center to center" are not supported by the page.
